# fortytwo

fortytwo is continuity infrastructure around an existing coding-agent runtime: identity, durable memory, session continuity, scheduled work and persistent channels. It does not reimplement what the runtime owns: reasoning, planning, tools, permissions, MCP servers, plugins, skills, browser/computer use or model choice. When the runtime gets better, the assistant gets better.

Claude Code is the only supported runtime today.

The answer is 42. The hard part is knowing the right question.

## Pages
- https://forty-two.it/ : overview
- https://forty-two.it/how-it-works : who owns what: you, fortytwo and the runtime
- https://forty-two.it/always-on : what 24/7 means, and running fortytwo on a laptop, a VPS or a homelab
- https://forty-two.it/runtimes : runtime support: what is supported today and where the boundary sits
- https://forty-two.it/trust : what fortytwo enforces and what it leaves to the runtime

## What it adds
- Identity: a persona and owner context kept in plain files in your project
- Memory: durable recall kept on your machine, with provenance
- Continuity: conversations can resume after a process restart (best effort)
- Time: scheduled work that wakes the agent only when there is work
- Channels: Telegram is the only channel adapter that ships today. It uses a bot for transport; the bot is not the assistant.

Channels share identity and durable memory. Each live conversation still has its own session context.

## Always on
Always on means the assistant infrastructure is available around the clock: the channel bridge, the scheduler, memory and identity. It does not mean the model runs continuously. The agent runtime is invoked when there is work, such as a message from the owner or a job that is due. fortytwo runs on a laptop, a VPS or a homelab; a VPS is not required. It runs in the foreground so a service manager or container runtime owns restarts and logs.

## What stays with the agent runtime
- Reasoning, planning and the model
- Tools and effective tool permissions
- MCP servers, plugins and skills
- Browser and computer use
- Channels such as Telegram carry messages and identity; they do not grant tool approvals
- Gate is an optional policy hook, not in the normal execution path unless enabled

## Quick start
```
npx @justfortytwo/installer init
fortytwo start
fortytwo pair
```
Then send the one-time code to your Telegram bot. Installation, configuration and reference are in the documentation.

Status: 1.0 pre-release. fortytwo runs no hosted backend for its own state.
